+                path = '/'.join(parent) + '/__init__.py'

+            output = os.path.join(*package_name) + '.py'
+            if output not in written:
+                zf.writestr(output, source)

+import zipfile
+from io import BytesIO
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.errors import AnsibleError
+from ansible.executor import module_common as common
+
+
+PREFIX = ('ansible_collections', 'demo', 'one', 'plugins', 'module_utils')
+
+
+def collection_files(mocker, files, routing=None):
+    mocker.patch.object(common, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={
+        'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': routing or {}}})
+    mocker.patch.object(common.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=lambda package, path: files.get(path))
+
+
+def test_collection_redirect_shim_and_fqcn(mocker):
+    files = {'plugins/module_utils/real.py': b'VALUE = 1\n'}
+    collection_files(mocker, files, {'old': {'redirect': 'demo.one.real'}})
+    locator = common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(PREFIX + ('old',))
+    assert locator.is_redirected
+    assert locator.normalized_name == PREFIX + ('old',)
+    assert b'ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils.real' in locator.source.encode()
+
+
+def test_collection_tombstone(mocker):
+    collection_files(mocker, {}, {'gone': {'tombstone': {
+        'warning_text': 'gone now', 'removal_version': '2.12'}}})
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='gone now'):
+        common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(PREFIX + ('gone',))
+
+
+def test_relative_package_imports_and_missing_package_levels(mocker):
+    files = {
+        'plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py': b'from .submod import VALUE\nfrom ..cousin.submod import OTHER\n',
+        'plugins/module_utils/pkg/submod.py': b'VALUE = 1\n',
+        'plugins/module_utils/cousin/submod.py': b'OTHER = 2\n',
+    }
+    collection_files(mocker, files)
+    output = BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as archive:
+        common.recursive_finder('example', 'ansible.modules.example',
+                                b'from ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils import pkg\n',
+                                set(), {}, archive)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(output.getvalue())) as archive:
+        names = set(archive.namelist())
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/pkg/submod.py' in names
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/cousin/submod.py' in names
+        assert archive.read('ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/cousin/__init__.py') == b''
+        assert archive.read('ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py') == files['plugins/module_utils/pkg/__init__.py']
+        assert 'ansible/__init__.py' in names
+        assert 'ansible/module_utils/__init__.py' in names
+
+
+def test_missing_collection_error(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(common, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=ValueError('unable to locate collection demo.one'))
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='unable to locate collection demo.one'):
+        common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(PREFIX + ('missing',))
+
+
+def test_candidate_names_only_for_deep_imports():
+    shallow = common.ModuleUtilLocatorBase(PREFIX + ('pkg',), True)
+    deep = common.ModuleUtilLocatorBase(PREFIX + ('pkg', 'symbol'), True)
+    assert shallow.candidate_names_joined() == ['.'.join(PREFIX + ('pkg',))]
+    assert deep.candidate_names_joined() == ['.'.join(PREFIX + ('pkg', 'symbol')),
+                                              '.'.join(PREFIX + ('pkg',))]
+
+
+def test_redirected_package_child_cross_collection(mocker):
+    def metadata(collection):
+        if collection == 'demo.one':
+            return {'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'old': {'redirect': 'demo.two.real'}}}}
+        return {}
+
+    files = {
+        ('ansible_collections.demo.two', 'plugins/module_utils/real/__init__.py'): b'from .child import VALUE\n',
+        ('ansible_collections.demo.two', 'plugins/module_utils/real/child.py'): b'VALUE = 42\n',
+    }
+    mocker.patch.object(common, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=metadata)
+    mocker.patch.object(common.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=lambda package, path: files.get((package, path)))
+    output = BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as archive:
+        common.recursive_finder('example', 'ansible.modules.example',
+                                b'import ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils.old.child\n',
+                                set(), {}, archive)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(output.getvalue())) as archive:
+        names = set(archive.namelist())
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/old/__init__.py' in names
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/old/child.py' in names
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/two/plugins/module_utils/real/__init__.py' in names
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/two/plugins/module_utils/real/child.py' in names
+
+
+def test_missing_dependency_lists_candidates(mocker):
+    collection_files(mocker, {})
+    output = BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as archive:
+        with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='Could not find imported module support code for ansible.modules.example') as exc:
+            common.recursive_finder('example', 'ansible.modules.example',
+                                    b'from ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils.pkg import missing\n',
+                                    set(), {}, archive)
+    assert 'ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils.pkg.missing' in str(exc.value)
+    assert 'ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils.pkg' in str(exc.value)
+
+
+def test_redirect_deprecation_emitted_when_resolved(mocker):
+    collection_files(mocker, {}, {'old': {'redirect': 'demo.one.new', 'deprecation': {
+        'warning_text': 'use new', 'removal_version': '3.0', 'removal_date': '2030-01-01'}}})
+    deprecated = mocker.patch.object(common.display, 'deprecated')
+    common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(PREFIX + ('old',))
+    deprecated.assert_called_once_with('use new', version=None, date='2030-01-01', collection_name='demo.one')
+
+
+def test_legacy_local_override_precedes_parent_redirect(mocker, tmp_path):
+    package = tmp_path / 'common'
+    package.mkdir()
+    (package / '__init__.py').write_text('')
+    (package / 'local.py').write_text('VALUE = 1\n')
+    mocker.patch.object(common, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={
+        'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'common': {'redirect': 'demo.one.other'}}}})
+    locator = common.LegacyModuleUtilLocator(('ansible', 'module_utils', 'common', 'local'), mu_paths=[str(tmp_path)])
+    assert locator.found and not locator.is_redirected
+    assert locator.source == b'VALUE = 1\n'
+    missing = common.LegacyModuleUtilLocator(('ansible', 'module_utils', 'common', 'missing'), mu_paths=[str(tmp_path)])
+    assert not missing.found
+
+
+def test_collection_namespace_levels_are_synthesized(mocker):
+    locator = common.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(('ansible_collections', 'demo', 'one', 'plugins'))
+    assert locator.found and locator.is_package
+    assert locator.source == b''
+    assert locator.output_path == 'ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/__init__.py'

+def test_redirected_package_from_import_distinguishes_attribute(mocker, name, expected_child):
+    def metadata(collection):
+        if collection == 'demo.one':
+            return {'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'old': {'redirect': 'demo.two.real'}}}}
+        return {}
+
+    files = {
+        ('ansible_collections.demo.two', 'plugins/module_utils/real/__init__.py'): b'VALUE = 42\n',
+        ('ansible_collections.demo.two', 'plugins/module_utils/real/child.py'): b'VALUE = 99\n',
+    }
+    mocker.patch.object(common, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=metadata)
+    mocker.patch.object(common.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=lambda package, path: files.get((package, path)))
+    output = BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'w') as archive:
+        common.recursive_finder('example', 'ansible.modules.example',
+                                ('from ansible_collections.demo.one.plugins.module_utils.old import %s\n' % name).encode(),
+                                set(), {}, archive)
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(output.getvalue())) as archive:
+        names = set(archive.namelist())
+        assert ('ansible_collections/demo/one/plugins/module_utils/old/child.py' in names) == expected_child
+        assert 'ansible_collections/demo/two/plugins/module_utils/real/__init__.py' in names
+        assert ('ansible_collections/demo/two/plugins/module_utils/real/child.py' in names) == expected_child
